WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) as type_count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(type_count) as avg_count,
    SUM(type_count) as total_count
  FROM trader_type_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.type_count as count,
  CAST(tc.type_count AS REAL) / s.total_count as proportion,
  CAST(tc.type_count AS REAL) - s.avg_count as difference
FROM trader_type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND tc.type_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY tc.tradekind
